root.policy: User-owned directory inside HOME; never install as root; do not replace the root or persistent data during updates.

directories.purpose: Versioned Node Core OS application source and runtime modules.
Stable user-level launchers and, on supported Linux distributions, the Kubo executable.
Reserved namespace for future configuration files; current canonical configuration remains config.json at the root.
Local Node Core OS user data and locally stored protocol/application content.
Kubo/IPFS repository, identity and decentralized storage metadata.
Node Core OS and Kubo runtime logs.
Private runtime environments, process state and updater work area.
Private Python virtual environment for Node Core OS.
Temporary update staging, backups and recovery metadata.
Reserved local service metadata and integration state; service-manager unit files remain in the platform XDG service directory.
Independent local lifecycle manager; can exist before Node Core OS installation.
Read-only canonical installation and layout manifests exposed by the Lobby.

files.purpose: Canonical Node Core OS configuration, including local storage and Kubo paths.
Source commit currently activated by the updater.

external_paths.purpose: Optional systemd user service unit; intentionally outside ~/.node-core.

invariants: The relative directory layout is identical for every standard installation.
The Lobby is installed independently and is not a prerequisite for the Node Core OS runtime.
The storage and ipfs directories are persistent user data and must never be removed or replaced by an application update.
The app directory is the replaceable application payload; updates preserve config.json, storage, ipfs, logs, identity and runtime state unless a separately documented migration is required.
The layout manifest is descriptive and versioned; installer code validates paths and creates only directories owned by its provisioner.
No private keys, credentials, tokens or secret contents are stored in this manifest.
